project_name: On Now Trivia (ON NOW TV V2)
design_philosophy: A high-tension, premium game-show experience. The TV is a cinematic, data-rich stage. The mobile phone is a tactile, zero-friction arcade controller. Do not mix their paradigms. TV = 10-foot UI with deep space and massive typography. Phone = Thumb-first, giant hit areas, physical-feeling haptics.

rules.tv_h1: text-7xl lg:text-8xl font-black tracking-tighter leading-none (Override text limit only for TV game show timer/massive states)

surfaces_and_effects.tv_glass: backdrop-blur-2xl bg-white/5 border border-white/10 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)] rounded-3xl
surfaces_and_effects.phone_tactile_button: relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border-b-8 active:border-b-0 active:translate-y-2 transition-all duration-75 shadow-lg

layouts.tv_lobby: grid grid-cols-12 gap-8 p-12 h-screen. Left col-span-4 (QR Code, Room Code, Join URL) tv_glass. Right col-span-8 (Dynamic grid of joining players). Asymmetrical, high tension.
layouts.tv_question: Flex column, centered vertically. Massive question text at top. 2x2 grid of answer options below. Giant horizontal timer bar at the very bottom spanning width.
layouts.phone_controller: Flex column, h-screen w-screen, overflow-hidden p-4. No scrolling. 100% viewport height.
layouts.phone_answers: Grid 2x2 gap-4 h-full pt-4. 4 massive buttons filling the screen height.

TV_Components.name: QRJoinPanel
TV_Components.description: Massive QR Code (use qrcode.react), 4-letter room code in JetBrains Mono.

TV_Components.name: PlayerChip
TV_Components.description: Avatar + Username. Animates in with scale/spring. TV surface.

TV_Components.name: CountdownTimer
TV_Components.description: Shrinking horizontal bar. Changes color from Brand -> Yellow -> Red as time drops.

TV_Components.name: LeaderboardRow
TV_Components.description: Flex row showing Rank, Avatar, Name, Score. Use framer-motion layout for rank swapping.

Phone_Components.name: TactileAnswerPad
Phone_Components.description: 4 massive colored buttons. Uses phone_tactile_button styling.

Phone_Components.name: GiantBuzzer
Phone_Components.description: Massive circular red button taking up 80% of the screen. Deep shadow, heavy press depression.

Phone_Components.name: StatusWaiting
Phone_Components.description: Simple screen. 'Look at the TV' pulsing text.

animation_motion.rules: High energy. Fast entrances, bouncy springs. No slow fades.
animation_motion.time_up: Screen shake effect on TV. Red flash.
animation_motion.button_press: Zero-latency active state. Transform translate-y-2 on mobile immediately. Do not use generic 'transition-all' on transforms.

tv_background.description: Abstract purple/pink dark energy background. Place as fixed background with mix-blend-screen and opacity-30 behind a solid #0A0A0A base.

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='answer-btn-a', data-testid='join-game-btn').
accessibility_and_testing.color_contrast: White text over neon answer buttons is guaranteed passing. Black text on primary cyan.
accessibility_and_testing.focus_states: Focus states must be explicitly styled ring-4 ring-white/50.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the app with standard React (.js). DO NOT USE .tsx

Simulate the Real-time WebSockets logic using a shared React Context or Mock State provider if actual websockets are out of scope. The TV and Phone views should toggleable or routed (e.g. /tv vs /play).
NEVER use generic placeholder images. Use the provided Unsplash URLs.
Implement the 'Two-Screen' architecture purely in the UI: Create a TV View layout and a Phone View layout. Do not mix them on the same screen.
For the phone controller, do not use Shadcn Cards. Use raw HTML/Tailwind to create the tactile, physical-feeling buttons (border-b-8 hack for depth).
Ensure 'Outfit' and 'DM Sans' are imported via Google Fonts.
universal_guidelines: Do not center-align everything by default. Use asymmetrical grids (e.g., TV Lobby).
Do not apply `transition: all` globally. Apply targeted transitions.
Create depth using z-index, large drop-shadows, and glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-2xl) specifically on the TV UI.
No emojis for icons. Use lucide-react.
